{{Top|leg}}
A '''zero-g sauna''' was a [[Sauna/Legends|sauna]] with zero [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] controls allowing individuals to float while enjoying the steam. The temperature range of a zero-g sauna was five hundred degrees. The [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] had a zero-g sauna available to passengers for post-[[gymnasium]] relaxation, as well as private zero-g saunas in the two suites.
